ImageDescription.value: French Pyrenees: The Cirque de Gavarnie is a cirque in the Pyrenees National Park. It is located directly on the border with Spain in the municipality of Gavarnie. The basin has a diameter of about two kilometers, lies at 1700 meters above sea level and is surrounded by mountains up to 3,250 meters high. An imposing mountain world.
